description: A destination is checked as a browser reads it, and percent-decoded before any query or fragment too (§4.5, C59): %5C%5Chost%5Cshare is a UNC path and Special%3ASearch has a scheme, so both are removed with link_scheme_blocked, keeping their text, as is a destination behind a no-break space; an encoded relative path and an encoded backslash in a query stay.
